subject: Physics
schema_note: Keyed by topic_id (matches physics_syllabus.json). Same field set as Maths file.

concepts: Propagation of errors in derived quantities
formulas: Δz/z = Δx/x + Δy/y for z=xy or x/y
methods: Always compute max % error via partial derivatives, not just add absolute errors blindly
Identify which experiment's formula is being tested before propagating error
traps: Adding absolute errors when the quantity is a product/quotient (should add % errors)
Ignoring least-count limit when reporting significant figures
hard_archetypes: Multi-quantity error propagation combining a power-law formula (e.g. g = 4π²L/T²)
Experiment-based conceptual question testing a specific NCERT setup (meter bridge, post office box) rather than pure error formula
banned_easy_templates: Direct 'round to correct significant figures' with no propagation step
out_of_scope: Statistical treatment beyond mean/error bars (no regression analysis)

methods: Resolve motion along/perpendicular to incline for projectile-on-incline problems
Use relative velocity vector diagrams for river-boat / rain-man problems
traps: Forgetting g direction sign convention when axes are rotated for incline problems
Confusing average speed with average velocity magnitude
hard_archetypes: Projectile motion with a moving frame of reference (relative velocity fused in)
Non-uniform circular motion requiring simultaneous tangential+radial analysis
Multi-stage motion (projectile then collision then second projectile)
banned_easy_templates: Plain 'find range/max height' with values plugged into standard formula
out_of_scope: Motion in non-Cartesian (polar) coordinates as a formal topic

methods: Draw free-body diagrams for each block separately before writing equations
Check whether friction is at limiting value before assuming kinetic friction acts
traps: Assuming friction is always kinetic without checking if the surfaces are actually slipping
Sign errors when combining pseudo-force with real forces in an accelerating frame
hard_archetypes: Multi-block systems with pulleys, friction, and constraint relations combined
Non-inertial frame problems (accelerating wedge/lift) requiring pseudo-force analysis
Problems where friction changes from static to kinetic mid-motion
banned_easy_templates: Single block on a horizontal surface, find friction force, no system/constraint
out_of_scope: Rolling friction as a separate formal quantity (only used qualitatively with rolling)

concepts: Power as a function of time in variable-force systems
methods: Use work-energy theorem directly rather than kinematics when force varies with position
Decompose 2D collisions into component-wise momentum conservation
traps: Applying 1D elastic-collision formulas directly to a 2D oblique collision
Forgetting energy is NOT conserved in inelastic collisions (only momentum is)
hard_archetypes: Variable-force work problems requiring integration of F(x) or F(t)
Oblique/2D collision problems combined with energy loss calculation
Multi-body collision chains (block hits block hits block)
banned_easy_templates: Constant-force work = F.d.cosθ with no variable force or system

concepts: Conservation of angular momentum with changing moment of inertia
formulas: For rolling down incline: a = g sinθ/(1+I/mR²)
methods: Use instantaneous axis of rotation to simplify torque/angular momentum about a moving point
Apply angular momentum conservation about a fixed axis when external torque about that axis is zero
traps: Applying τ=Iα about a non-fixed/non-CM axis without justification
Forgetting friction provides the torque needed for rolling without slipping (not always kinetic)
hard_archetypes: Rolling body on incline/rough surface combined with impulsive collision
System with changing moment of inertia (person walking on rotating disc)
Rigid body toppling/critical-angle problems combining torque and friction
banned_easy_templates: Find moment of inertia of a standard shape from the formula sheet directly
out_of_scope: Gyroscopic precession (not explicitly in JEE Advanced syllabus)

concepts: Gravitational field/potential due to extended bodies (shell, sphere)
formulas: T² proportional to r³ (Kepler's third law)
methods: Use energy conservation (KE+PE) for orbit transfer/escape problems rather than force equations alone
Apply shell theorem to reduce extended-body gravitation problems to point-mass equivalents
traps: Sign errors with gravitational PE (always negative, taken zero at infinity)
Confusing orbital velocity with escape velocity by a factor of √2
hard_archetypes: Orbit transfer (Hohmann-style) problems requiring energy at two radii
Gravitational field due to a non-uniform or partially removed spherical mass
Combined satellite + relative motion / collision problem
banned_easy_templates: Direct substitution into v=sqrt(GM/r) with given numbers only

formulas: For springs in parallel: k_eff = k1+k2
methods: Identify the effective restoring force/torque first, then match to SHM form -ω²x
Use energy method (KE+PE=const) instead of full differential equation for amplitude/speed questions
traps: Assuming any periodic motion is SHM without verifying restoring force is linear in displacement
Errors combining spring constants when springs act in a non-obvious geometric configuration
hard_archetypes: SHM of a system requiring derivation of effective 'k' from a non-spring restoring mechanism (e.g. floating body, rod on a pivot)
Two-spring combined SHM with an intermediate mass or pulley
SHM combined with collision (a moving object embeds into an oscillating mass)
banned_easy_templates: Find T for a given mass-spring system with k, m given directly
out_of_scope: Forced oscillation transient response beyond resonance qualitative treatment

concepts: Bernoulli's theorem with varying pipe cross-section
Surface tension in capillary rise / bubble pressure excess
formulas: Excess pressure in a bubble (soap) = 4T/r; in a drop = 2T/r
methods: Apply continuity equation (A1v1=A2v2) alongside Bernoulli for varying pipe problems
Track buoyancy + viscous + gravity forces separately before combining for terminal velocity
traps: Forgetting soap bubble has two surfaces (factor of 4T/r, not 2T/r)
Using Bernoulli across a region where energy is NOT conserved (viscous losses present)
hard_archetypes: Efflux/draining-tank problems combining Bernoulli + continuity + time-varying height
Terminal velocity problems with a changing medium (settling through two fluids)
Capillary rise combined with a temperature-dependent surface tension
banned_easy_templates: Plain 'find excess pressure inside a bubble' with r, T given directly

concepts: Doppler effect with both source and observer moving
Beats frequency from two close frequencies
methods: Draw the standing wave pattern (nodes/antinodes) before assigning the harmonic formula
Carefully assign sign convention (source/observer approaching vs receding) before substituting into Doppler formula
traps: Using open-pipe harmonic formula for a closed pipe (only odd harmonics exist in closed pipe)
Sign errors in Doppler formula when both source and observer move
hard_archetypes: Doppler effect with reflection off a moving wall/observer (double Doppler shift)
Superposition of multiple traveling waves producing a resultant with time-varying amplitude
String/pipe resonance combined with temperature-dependent speed of sound
banned_easy_templates: Find fundamental frequency of a string with L, v given directly

concepts: First law applied to non-standard processes (polytropic)
formulas: Thermal resistance R = L/kA (series/parallel like electrical resistance)
methods: Treat composite conducting rods with the same electrical-circuit-style series/parallel resistance method
Identify process type (isothermal/adiabatic/isochoric/isobaric) before choosing the work formula
traps: Using PV=const formula for an adiabatic process (should be PV^γ=const)
Forgetting sign convention: work done BY gas vs ON gas in first law statement used
hard_archetypes: Cyclic process problems requiring net work via P-V diagram area + efficiency calculation
Composite rod heat conduction combined with radiation loss at the ends
Polytropic process problems requiring derivation of molar heat capacity
banned_easy_templates: Direct substitution into ideal gas law PV=nRT with no process/cycle
out_of_scope: Statistical mechanics derivation of entropy (only classical thermodynamic entropy)

concepts: Gauss's law for non-uniform/asymmetric charge distributions
Continuous charge distribution field/potential via integration
formulas: V = kQ/r for point charge; superposition for systems
methods: Choose a Gaussian surface that exploits the symmetry of the charge distribution
Integrate dE or dV directly for charge distributions lacking high symmetry (rod, arc)
traps: Applying Gauss's law to a surface where E is not constant/perpendicular (invalid shortcut)
Forgetting a dipole in a non-uniform field experiences a net force, not just torque
hard_archetypes: Field/potential due to a non-uniformly charged sphere or rod requiring integration
System of multiple charges/dipoles requiring superposition + energy calculation
Charge distribution with a cavity (superposition trick: real + fictitious negative charge)
banned_easy_templates: Coulomb's law force between two point charges with given q, r
out_of_scope: Electric field inside a dielectric medium beyond basic polarization concept

concepts: Dielectric slab partially filling a capacitor
Energy redistribution when capacitors are connected
formulas: Energy loss on connecting charged capacitors = C1C2(V1-V2)²/2(C1+C2)
methods: Use symmetry (equal potential nodes) to simplify complex capacitor networks before series/parallel reduction
Track charge conservation separately from voltage when capacitors are reconnected
traps: Applying V-doubling naively when capacitors of different capacitance are connected (charge redistributes, not voltage)
Forgetting energy is lost as heat when charged capacitors are connected (not conserved)
hard_archetypes: Non-trivial capacitor bridge networks requiring symmetry or Δ-Y-style reduction
Partially-filled dielectric capacitor combined with a moving-slab (variable capacitance) scenario
Multi-capacitor charging/discharging via a battery with switches at multiple stages
banned_easy_templates: Two capacitors in series or parallel, given C1, C2, compute C_eq directly

methods: Assign loop currents systematically (mesh analysis) for multi-loop circuits before applying KVL
Check for a balanced bridge (no current through galvanometer) before solving generally
traps: Sign errors in KVL when traversing a loop against assumed current direction
Treating an unbalanced Wheatstone bridge as if it were balanced
hard_archetypes: Multi-loop resistor networks requiring full Kirchhoff's law solution (not reducible by series/parallel)
RC circuit problems with a switch changing configuration mid-transient
Hybrid problems combining a Wheatstone-bridge-like network with a capacitor
banned_easy_templates: Simple series/parallel resistor combination, find equivalent resistance
out_of_scope: AC circuit analysis (covered separately under P15)

concepts: Force on a current loop in a non-uniform field
Magnetic field due to combined current-carrying geometries
Motion of a charged particle in combined E and B fields (velocity selector, cyclotron)
methods: Superpose fields from multiple current elements/segments using Biot-Savart before combining
Separate the charged-particle motion into components parallel and perpendicular to B (helical motion)
traps: Sign errors in cross product direction (right-hand rule) for force/field direction
Forgetting the component of velocity parallel to B is unaffected by the magnetic force
hard_archetypes: Charged particle in combined E and B fields following a helical/cycloidal path
Magnetic field due to a combination of straight wires and arcs at a point
Current loop in a non-uniform magnetic field experiencing both force and torque
banned_easy_templates: Find B at the centre of a single circular loop with I, R given directly

concepts: Motional EMF in a moving/rotating conductor
LCR series resonance and phasor analysis
methods: Use phasor diagrams to combine R, L, C voltage/current relationships in AC circuits
Apply Lenz's law direction reasoning before computing EMF magnitude
traps: Sign errors in Lenz's law direction (induced current opposes the change, not the field itself)
Confusing peak and rms values when computing power in AC circuits
hard_archetypes: Rod sliding on rails in a magnetic field with an additional circuit element (combined EMF + circuit analysis)
LCR circuit problems requiring resonance condition plus power factor calculation
Mutual inductance problems with two coupled circuits and a time-varying current
banned_easy_templates: Compute EMF = -dΦ/dt for a simple linear flux change with no circuit interaction
out_of_scope: Three-phase AC systems, transformers beyond basic mutual inductance idea

concepts: EM wave field relationships (E, B, propagation direction)
EM spectrum band identification and use-cases
methods: Use the mutual perpendicularity of E, B, and propagation direction to deduce missing field components
Cross-reference EM spectrum band with typical frequency/wavelength range for identification questions
traps: Confusing E0/B0 ratio direction (which one is larger in SI units)
Mixing up frequency ranges of adjacent EM spectrum bands
hard_archetypes: Problems combining EM wave intensity with radiation pressure calculations
Given E(x,t) or B(x,t) expression, deduce the other field and propagation direction
banned_easy_templates: Direct 'name the EM spectrum band for this wavelength' recall question
out_of_scope: Maxwell's equations in full differential form (only qualitative treatment)

concepts: Lens/mirror combination with intermediate image formation
Minimum deviation condition for a prism
methods: Treat each optical element sequentially: output image of one becomes object for the next
Use lateral shift / apparent depth formulas explicitly for slab-refraction problems rather than re-deriving
traps: Sign convention errors (Cartesian sign convention inconsistency between mirror and lens formulas)
Forgetting virtual image distances/heights carry sign in magnification formulas
hard_archetypes: Multi-element optical system (lens+mirror+lens) requiring sequential image tracing
Prism problems requiring derivation near minimum deviation or grazing incidence
Combined refraction-through-slab and lens-image problems with total internal reflection check
banned_easy_templates: Single thin lens, find image distance from u and f directly

concepts: Fringe shift due to inserted slab in YDSE
Polarization by reflection (Brewster's angle) and by Polaroids (Malus's law)
formulas: Single slit minima: a sinθ = nλ
methods: Track path difference changes explicitly when a slab/medium is introduced in one arm of YDSE
Distinguish diffraction minima condition (single slit) from interference maxima condition (double slit) carefully
traps: Using double-slit interference formulas for a single-slit diffraction problem or vice versa
Forgetting central diffraction maximum is twice as wide as secondary maxima
hard_archetypes: YDSE with a dielectric slab inserted in one slit, find resulting fringe shift/pattern change
Combined interference-diffraction envelope problems (double slit within diffraction envelope)
Polarization problems chaining multiple Polaroids at different angles
banned_easy_templates: Find fringe width given λ, D, d directly with no modification
out_of_scope: Diffraction gratings with resolving power formalism beyond basic condition

concepts: Radioactive decay chains and activity calculations
Nuclear binding energy per nucleon trends
methods: Use energy-level diagrams to identify which transition matches a given photon energy/wavelength
Separate decay-chain problems into successive N(t) equations for parent and daughter nuclei
traps: Forgetting work function φ varies by material in photoelectric problems
Confusing half-life with mean life in decay calculations (factor of ln2)
hard_archetypes: Sequential radioactive decay chain (parent->daughter->granddaughter) activity problems
Photoelectric effect combined with de Broglie wavelength of emitted electron
Nuclear reaction Q-value problems requiring mass-defect and binding energy calculation
banned_easy_templates: Direct substitution into E_n=-13.6/n² for hydrogen with no transition/comparison
out_of_scope: Quantum field theory, particle physics beyond basic nuclear/atomic models
